QUOTE: Nothing is extension-filtered. `enumerate_tree` hands every file under the roots to the pipeline, so hashing and invalidation see any change. Files that no grammar handles are simply not indexed; the `files` inventory counts only what the index holds.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says files no grammar handles aren't indexed, but it never names the parse-built front end claiming file types doxygen can't read, or binary classification dropping files whose extension lies about them.
